title: Codex telemetry
description: User and session activity, model usage and waiting time from Codex telemetry. Generated; see docs/integrations/codex-dashboard.md.

list.name: user
list.label: User email
list.description: Literal email search; blank includes everyone, including unattributed traffic.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.description: Literal conversation ID search; blank includes all sessions. Click a session row to select it.

links.title: Export PNG
links.tooltip: Full dashboard image; allow up to 3 minutes. Uses the selected time range and filters.

options.content: Search by email or click a session. Clear searches for everyone. Session times are observed bounds; identity coverage is fleet-wide.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Distinct conversations with meaningful events in the selected period; not session launches.

targets.expr: count(sum by (session)(count_over_time({job=~"codex-app-server|codex_cli_rs"} | json event="attributes[\"event.name\"]", user="attributes[\"user.email\"]", session="attributes[\"conversation.id\"]", model="attributes[\"model\"]", kind="attributes[\"event.kind\"]", input_tokens="attributes[\"input_token_count\"]", output_tokens="attributes[\"output_token_count\"]", cached_tokens="attributes[\"cached_token_count\"]", ttft_ms="attributes[\"ttft_ms\"]", duration_ms="attributes[\"duration_ms\"]" | __error__="" | user=~`.*${user:regex}.*` | session=~`.*${session:regex}.*` | event=~"codex.user_prompt|codex.tool_result|codex.sse_event" | (event!="codex.sse_event" or kind="response.completed") | session!=""[$__range])))
